name: nodejs-learning
description: - Node.js is a JavaScript runtime environment. - Node.js was created by Ryan Dahl. - Node.js uses Google's V8 JavaScript engine. - Node.js allows JavaScript to run outside the browser. - Node.js does not have browser objects like `window` and `document`. - LTS means Long-Term Support and is generally preferred for stable development. - npm (Node Package Manager) comes with Node.js and is used to install and manage packages.
